title: Phone audio focus set fresh for every item and clip; focus loss handled and logged
found_by: TJ in a Ford truck over Bluetooth, 2026-11-13

requirements.text: Focus is re-requested before every item and clip, and loss is tracked
requirements.check: file: AudioHold.renew called in Walker.speakCurrent and play; listener sets holding

requirements.text: Every focus change and renewal shows in the bridge log

evidence: AudioHold.renew re-requests focus while reasons non-empty; called at Walker.speakCurrent (before each item) and play() (before each clip); listener sets holding from the change; gradlew testDebugUnitTest passes
AudioHold.log set in Walker init to link.diag; listener logs gained/lost/lost for now/asked to duck; renew logs refused or regained

fields.symptom: In a Ford truck over Bluetooth, music and speech fought: speech went quiet, music came back mid-walk
fields.root_cause: AudioHold requested focus once per walk with an empty listener: a loss (head unit or music taking focus back) left holding=true, so focus was never asked for again
whys: the focus listener was a stub
fields.corrective: renew before each item and clip; listener tracks holding; every change logged
fields.preventive: focus changes in the bridge log make the next car glitch diagnosable
fields.gate: read the bridge log after a car test

answers.observed: code read: setOnAudioFocusChangeListener { } and holding never reset
answers.cause: the stub listener is measured in code; that the Ford took focus is a hypothesis, no focus log existed
answers.absence: no focus-change record from the truck: the logging is new in this build
answers.assumption: head unit honours a renewed focus request; if SYNC ignores focus, renewing changes nothing and the log will show granted while music still plays
answers.falsify: car test log: 'audio focus: lost' never appears, yet music plays over speech

text: Truck test on 0.1.456398 22:53:32: 'clip route captured' then the speech-usage clip still 'on 25 (captured: not heard)'. Assumption falsified: the capture takes USAGE_ASSISTANT too. Likely Android Auto projection. Trying USAGE_ASSISTANCE_NAVIGATION_GUIDANCE, which head units play over any source.

0.1.456414 (navigation-guidance usage for captured routes) shipped and link sent to the Assistant; not installed on the phone as of the 30m watch (no 'build 0.1.456414' in the bridge log). Next: on install, read bridge log for 'playing as navigation guidance' and the clip's route.

FALSIFIED on 0.1.456589 at 02:15:29-39 UTC: clips played as navigation guidance still went to route 25 (captured: not heard), 4 of 4. The arrival line fell back to the built-in voice at 02:15:28 (no clip within 2500ms); whether TJ heard that is unknown. Next: ask TJ if he heard 'One update' in the built-in voice; if yes, use the built-in voice whenever the route is captured.

RECHECKED: route 25 is not 'unheard'. TJ, 02:23 UTC on 0.1.456589: 'No it's been working actually really well' (heard the clips that logged on 25). Remote submix is how a projecting car (Android Auto) carries phone audio, so my 'captured: not heard' label was a hypothesis, now falsified. Label changed locally, not shipped. No built-in-voice switch. Which change fixed the silent spell (focus renew vs guidance usage) is not separable from the logs.
